description: Introduces scripts/intake/hardened_runner.py — a bounded execution path for arbitrary-repo intake. Migrates BuildAdapter._run (scripts/intake/build_adapters.py) and ShadowCompiler.{compile,run_tests,_shadow_compile_python} (scripts/codebase_explorer.py) to route through it. The 5 repair-pipeline sites under scripts/repair/ are explicitly deferred per directive ('Do not rewrite the entire repair pipeline in this rung unless it is low-risk').
purpose: Rung 5 of the post-audit Claude-lane sequence. Consumes the MUST_MIGRATE target list from PARALLEL_EXECUTION_LAYER_AUDIT_LOCK_001 (rung 4). After this rung, arbitrary-repo intake CANNOT accidentally invoke shell=True, escape the workspace, invoke Docker, or run with code-injection env vars present. The repair-pipeline migration is the explicit target of a follow-up rung.

runner_api.entry_point: run(cmd, *, workspace, timeout, extra_env=None, cwd=None, allow_docker=False, allow_network=False) -> RunResult
runner_api.result_dataclass: RunResult(command, cwd, exit_code, stdout, stderr, timed_out, tool_missing, blocked, reason, scrubbed_env_vars)

guards_enforced.COMMAND_BLOCKED_SHELL: Shell strings rejected; argv must be list[str] of str only; subprocess.run always called with shell=False (defensive monkeypatch test asserts this).
guards_enforced.COMMAND_BLOCKED_PATH_ESCAPE: cwd must resolve inside workspace via Path.is_relative_to; ../.. escape, sibling dirs, and absolute paths outside workspace all blocked.
guards_enforced.COMMAND_BLOCKED_DOCKER: First-argv check refuses docker / docker-compose / podman / buildah / kubectl / helm (and .exe variants). allow_docker=True opts in; Claude lane never sets it.
guards_enforced.COMMAND_NETWORK_REFUSED: First-argv check refuses curl / wget / ncat / netcat / nc. allow_network=True opts in.
guards_enforced.COMMAND_TIMEOUT_STRUCTURED: Zero/negative/non-int timeouts blocked. Caller timeout clamped to MAX_TIMEOUT_S=600. TimeoutExpired translated to timed_out=True (never raises).
guards_enforced.ENVIRONMENT_SCRUBBED: 16 known code-injection / shell-startup vars stripped from child env unconditionally (LD_PRELOAD, LD_LIBRARY_PATH, LD_AUDIT, DYLD_*, PYTHONSTARTUP, PYTHONHOME, PYTHONUSERBASE, IFS, PS4, BASH_ENV, ENV, FCEDIT, TMPPREFIX, PROMPT_COMMAND). extra_env cannot smuggle them in.
guards_enforced.BAD_WORKSPACE: Workspace must exist as a directory.

scripts/intake/build_adapters.py.what_changed: _run() now delegates to hardened_runner.run; PythonAdapter.run_shadow_build per-file py_compile loop also routes through hardened_runner.run

scripts/codebase_explorer.py.what_changed: ShadowCompiler.compile, ShadowCompiler.run_tests, and ShadowCompiler._shadow_compile_python all now route through hardened_runner.run with extra_env={'PYTHONWARNINGS': 'ignore'}
scripts/codebase_explorer.py.compat_preserved: CODEBASE_EXPLORER_SMOKE_LOCK_001 tests (12) all still pass; explore() against python_broken fixture still produces pip/pytest/test_failure finding

scripts/repair/*.py.rationale: Per directive: 'Do not rewrite the entire repair pipeline in this rung unless it is low-risk.' Each repair pipeline owns its own _default_executor (Executor protocol) plus per-language test coverage; coordinated migration belongs in HARDENED_REPAIR_PIPELINE_EXECUTORS_LOCK_001.

invariants: hardened_runner.run never raises into the caller; every failure mode is a RunResult field.
Shell strings (str cmd) are blocked; argv must be list[str] of str only.
subprocess.run is always called with shell=False (defensive monkeypatch test asserts this).
cwd MUST resolve inside workspace; absolute paths outside, ../.. traversal, and sibling-dir cwd are all blocked.
Docker/container runtimes (docker, podman, buildah, kubectl, helm + .exe variants) blocked by default; opt-in via allow_docker=True.
Network programs (curl, wget, nc, ncat, netcat) blocked by default; opt-in via allow_network=True.
16 env vars (LD_PRELOAD, DYLD_INSERT_LIBRARIES, PYTHONSTARTUP, BASH_ENV, ...) stripped from child env unconditionally; cannot be smuggled via extra_env.
Timeout must be positive int; clamped to MAX_TIMEOUT_S=600; TimeoutExpired -> timed_out=True.
BuildAdapter._run is wired to hardened_runner.run (source-level import test verifies this).
ShadowCompiler {compile, run_tests, _shadow_compile_python} are all wired to hardened_runner.run (source-level import test verifies all three migration sites).
All remaining MUST_MIGRATE sites are in scripts/repair/ — verified by test_parallel_audit_must_migrate_reduced_to_repair_pipelines_only.
hardened_runner.py classifies as HARDENED_COMPILER_PATH in the parallel execution audit.
Source tree, signed evidence, and corpus stay unmutated during runner exercise.

compat_preserved.PARALLEL_EXECUTION_LAYER_AUDIT_LOCK_001: 27/27 pass (rung-4 lock's BLOCKED_UNSAFE=0 still pinned; doc regenerated to match new counts)

remaining_gaps: 5 MUST_MIGRATE sites remain in scripts/repair/ (one per language pipeline). Targeted by the next-but-one rung HARDENED_REPAIR_PIPELINE_EXECUTORS_LOCK_001.
121 UNKNOWN_REQUIRES_REVIEW sites unchanged by this rung — they need triage independently (top-level scripts/ helpers like determinex_fullbench, micro_eval, swe_run/repo.py).

Hardened runner uses raw subprocess.run under the hood. The hardening is at the policy layer (argv validation, cwd, env scrub, blocklists), not at the OS layer (no seccomp / no AppArmor / no Job Object). For inference-side oracle work, hive/compiler.py provides the OS-level sandbox; the hardened runner provides intake-side policy enforcement.
Network blocklist is first-argv based; a custom HTTP client invoked via python -c '...' is not blocked. Acceptable for intake; the cloak/sentinel layer handles cloud-egress policy.
Env scrub uses a hard-coded denylist of 16 vars. Future work: add DETERMINEX_HARDENED_RUNNER_EXTRA_BLOCKLIST env var so operators can extend the list without code change.

Repair pipelines accept an Executor callable; the cleanest migration is to set the default Executor to a hardened-runner-backed implementation in each pipeline. Each pipeline has its own lock (PYTHON_REPAIR_LOCK_001, RUST_REPAIR_LOCK_001, GO_REPAIR_LOCK_001, TYPESCRIPT_REPAIR_LOCK_001, NATIVE_C_CPP_REPAIR_LOCK_001) so the migration must preserve each one's existing test contracts.
